_comment: Reference MCP servers used by the protocol run (protocol.md sections 4.1-4.2). Each entry is a candidate: `included` says whether this pass executed it and `reason` gives the ground for the decision, so the report disclosure block can carry the full candidate list instead of a convenience sample. launch.argv is relative to --server-root; {python} is the interpreter used for the server process; {data_dir} is the per-repetition data directory. env adds variables the server itself reads (data-directory isolation); the harness additionally points USERPROFILE/HOME at a fresh directory per repetition, which isolates servers whose storage path is derived from the home directory.

servers.name: sint-liquid-mcp
servers.reason: memory-oriented MCP server from the SINT reference set; executable on this host with the pinned dependency set (mcp 1.9.4); exposes the write/read/revise operations needed by T1/T2/T5

servers.name: sint-memory-mcp
servers.reason: hash-chained block memory inside the SINT core repository; executable on this host with the same pinned dependency set; a different storage design from sint-liquid-mcp (append-only chain with registers and provenance), so the two profiles are comparable but not duplicated

servers.name: sint-epistemic-mcp
servers.reason: imports the standalone fastmcp distribution, which could not be installed on this host in this pass (pip aborted with Errno 28, disk full: 0.12 GB free of 237 GB). Excluded for a host-capability reason, not a quality judgement

servers.name: sint-dream-mcp
servers.reason: same blocking dependency as sint-epistemic-mcp (standalone fastmcp not installable here); would be the natural subject for T6 consolidation once installable, because it exposes dream_consolidate

servers.name: sint-prospective-mcp
servers.reason: executable on this host and the right subject for T7 (intention stack), but it has no fact store, so T1/T2/T5 cannot be exercised on it; deferred to a follow-up card that measures O5_INTEND against it

servers.name: sint-llm-swarm
servers.reason: not a memory store (multi-agent orchestration over a cache directory) and blocked by the same fastmcp dependency

servers.name: sint-memory-mcp (mcp/working)
servers.reason: second memory server inside the same repository (mcp/working); excluded to keep the per-repository sample at one server and to avoid two subjects sharing a commit
